title: MegaBackpack
description: A high-speed pocket inventory with 27 storage slots, accessible anywhere by pressing the N key!
body:
Tired of having a full inventory after only 5 minutes of mining? MegaBackpack is here to save your adventures!

This mod adds an ultra-simple and fast-access mobile storage system for all explorers. Whether you're clearing a complex structure or mining deep underground, you'll never be held back by a lack of space again.

✨ Key Features:
Optimal Capacity: A pocket inventory with 27 additional slots (the equivalent of a single chest).

Instant Access: No need to place a block on the ground. Open your bag anywhere, anytime, simply by pressing the N key!

Optimized for NeoForge: Designed to provide a smooth, lightweight, and lag-free experience on the latest versions of Minecraft.

Fast & Practical: Perfect for sorting your precious resources during intensive farming sessions.

Don't leave your diamonds behind anymore for lack of space. Install MegaBackpack and head out on your adventure with peace of mind!
